targets.name: Carved heron on roof bracket
targets.concealment: A heron is carved into the same weathered timber as the structural bracket, amid leaf scrolls.

targets.name: Fish chime ornament
targets.concealment: The small earth-colored fish chime is nested below a dark bell amid dangling cords and foliage.

targets.name: Flying bird wall inlay
targets.concealment: The gold bird is a flat inlay embedded in the similarly colored waves and leaves of a tile panel.

targets.name: Bamboo-resting dragonfly
targets.concealment: Thin translucent wings align with bamboo rods and leaves, sharing their warm beige texture.

targets.name: Butterfly among wisteria
targets.concealment: The tan patterned wings mingle with wisteria petals and similarly shaped dry leaves.

targets.name: Owl in the alcove
targets.concealment: The small brown owl is recessed in a shadowed kiln niche with matching stone and pottery tones.

targets.name: Snail shell in the bowl
targets.concealment: The brown shell blends with shelf grain and a bowl lip partly screens its lower edge.

targets.name: Green pond frog
targets.concealment: The green frog is surrounded by matching foliage, water reflections and mossy masonry.

targets.name: Terracotta wall lizard
targets.concealment: The low-relief lizard follows the terracotta coping tile and shares its warm glaze and mottling; the tail continues beyond the scene edge.

targets.name: Pottery crab relief
targets.concealment: The crab is molded into a patterned green pot in the same worn clay and glaze.

targets.name: Pale fish on blue jar
targets.concealment: The fish motif is embedded among matching gold leaves and waves on the large dark-blue jar.

targets.name: Fresh bowl on the wheel
targets.concealment: The large unglazed bowl is the clear center of the work area.

targets.name: Tall blue lidded jar
targets.concealment: The large blue lidded jar is an obvious shelf anchor; its visible contour follows the bracket, bird and bowl in front.

targets.name: Basket of clay lumps
targets.concealment: The large wicker basket is clearly visible in the lower corner.

targets.name: Stone pond tortoise
targets.concealment: The tortoise is distinct on the pool ledge.

review.notes: All 15 targets inspected with enlarged source ROIs and final context-outline sheet. Full heron crest/feet, both wall-bird wings and tail, dragonfly head/abdomen/legs, butterfly profile, owl stone/foliage occlusion, complete spiral shell, frog and lizard appendages, crab claws/legs, actual upright fish motif, bowl back rim, lidded-jar occlusions, basket handle/foliage, and tortoise head/feet traced. Actual handle/claw/leg openings retained as holes. All geometry valid. Physical iPhone review remains pending.
